notes: Seed pool for the daily Health Papers Agent (5/day). Each topic = one health problem with a druggable target, a reference drug, and a computational angle. Topics already used by Papers #1-#4 are EXCLUDED here (thymoquinone/aldose-reductase, dual AR+SGLT2, GLP-1/Parkinson BBB, p-tau217). The picker must also check the tracker before selecting. PDB is auto-picked by the LeadForge pipeline at run time — do not hard-code a PDB here unless verified.
